basic_details.job_title: IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Facility administrator, Centre Attendant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Management Mumbai (IIM Mumbai) has announced 3 vacancies for Facility administrator and Centre Attendant posts on a contract basis. The engagement is temporary initially for one year, extendable further subject to satisfactory performance, with a maximum tenure of 2 years. Qualifications and pay vary by post, with Facility administrator offering Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 40,000 per month and Centre Attendant offering Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 30,000 per month. how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates may submit their form online by visiting https://iimmumbai.ac.in/careers on or before 31 October 2026. No other mode of application will be entertained.
Candidates are required to mandatorily mention their email ID in the application form.
Candidates must pay a non-refundable application processing fee of Rs 590 (Rupees Five Hundred Ninety only).
Candidates belonging to SC, ST, and PwD are exempted from paying the application fee.
All internal candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.
important_instructions: The position is purely contractual for AIC-NIFIE and candidate(s) will have no right to claim regularisation or absorption in the institute. The contract basis engagement will start only after the funds are released by Nayara Energy and received by AIC-NIFIE. The panel of selected waitlisted candidates will be valid for one year from the date of approval of the Competent Authority, and the institute can also make appointments in future by operating the panel within the validity period. In case of any inadvertent mistake in the process of selection, which may be detected at any stage, even after issue of the appointment letter, the institute reserves the right to modify, withdraw or cancel any communication made to the candidates. The institute reserves the right not to fill the post, if it so desires. No interim correspondence will be entertained. The institute follows the Reservation Policy of the Government of India. No TA/DA or any other incidental expenses will be reimbursed to participate in the interview process. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Legal disputes, if any, will be restricted within the jurisdiction of Mumbai only. Candidates are advised to visit the website of IIM Mumbai (www.iimmumbai.ac.in) regularly for any updates, amendments, and corrigendum, which will be placed only on the institute website.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies have been notified across unreserved positions at AIC-NIFIE, IIM Mumbai. Candidates who have already applied for the post of Centre Attendant need not apply again. Their earlier applications will also be considered.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must be not more than 40 years as of the last date of submission of the application (31 October 2026). The crucial date for determining the age limit is the closing date for the receipt of applications. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration for Facility administrator ranges from Rs 30,000 to Rs 40,000 per month, while for Centre Attendant it ranges from Rs 25,000 to Rs 30,000 per month. The contractual appointment is initially for a period of one year, extendable further subject to satisfactory performance and institute requirement, with a maximum tenure of two years. Leave benefits are provided as per extant institute norms applicable to contractual employees. No other allowances are admissible, and the institute will not provide accommodation facilities. The contract will start only after the funds are released by Nayara Energy and received by AIC-NIFIE.

content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Incubator Facility Administrator (on contract basis) reports to the CEO - Innovation, Incubation and Entrepreneurship. Responsible for overall administration and smooth functioning of the incubation facility, including co-working spaces, labs, and common infrastructure. Ensure proper allocation, utilization, and upkeep of workspace, meeting rooms, and shared facilities for incubated startups. Oversee maintenance and servicing of infrastructure, including electrical systems, HVAC, furniture, and utilities. Coordinate with vendors and service providers for facility management, repairs, housekeeping, and security services. Monitor and ensure uninterrupted functioning of internet, communication systems, and access control systems. Maintain asset registers and inventory of all equipment, furniture, and infrastructure within the incubator. Assist in procurement processes related to facility requirements, including vendor identification, quotations, and documentation. Ensure compliance with safety norms, statutory requirements, and institute guidelines within the incubation facility. Support startups and stakeholders by addressing facility-related issues promptly and efficiently. Coordinate logistics and arrangements for meetings, events, workshops, and incubation programs. Maintain documentation and records related to facility usage, maintenance schedules, and service reports. Liaise with IIM Mumbai administration and AIC-NIFIE for operational coordination and reporting. Prepare periodic reports on facility utilization, maintenance status, and operational efficiency. Assist in the day-to-day operations and smooth functioning of the Incubation Centre. Ensure cleanliness, upkeep and proper maintenance of workspaces, meeting rooms and common facilities. Assist startups, visitors and stakeholders with routine facility-related requirements. Coordinate with housekeeping, security, maintenance staff and service providers for day-to-day requirements. Provide logistical support for meetings, workshops, events and incubation programmes. Assist in maintaining inventory, facility records and other administrative documentation. Report facility-related issues and support timely resolution. Perform other duties as assigned by the Facility Administrator/CEO – Innovation, Incubation and Entrepreneurship.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates may submit their form online by visiting https://iimmumbai.ac.in/careers on or before 31 October 2026. No other mode of application will be entertained. Candidates are required to mandatorily mention their email ID in the application form. Candidates must pay a non-refundable application processing fee of Rs 590 (Rupees Five Hundred Ninety only). Candidates belonging to SC, ST, and PwD are exempted from paying the application fee. All internal candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be carried out through an interview, which may also be conducted through in person or online mode. Mere fulfillment of the eligibility criteria does not guarantee that the applicant will be shortlisted for the interview. The institute reserves the right to restrict the number of shortlisted candidates for further recruitment process to a reasonable number on the basis of higher qualifications and/or experience. The date for the interview will be communicated later to the shortlisted candidates through email only. Candidates are advised to check their emails regularly. Shortlisted candidates will be required to bring all original certificates, degrees, and other documents pertaining to their educational qualification, professional qualification, work experience, age, etc., for verification purposes at the time of the interview, along with one set of photocopies of these documents.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is purely contractual for AIC-NIFIE and candidate(s) will have no right to claim regularisation or absorption in the institute. The contract basis engagement will start only after the funds are released by Nayara Energy and received by AIC-NIFIE. The panel of selected waitlisted candidates will be valid for one year from the date of approval of the Competent Authority, and the institute can also make appointments in future by operating the panel within the validity period. In case of any inadvertent mistake in the process of selection, which may be detected at any stage, even after issue of the appointment letter, the institute reserves the right to modify, withdraw or cancel any communication made to the candidates. The institute reserves the right not to fill the post, if it so desires. No interim correspondence will be entertained. The institute follows the Reservation Policy of the Government of India. No TA/DA or any other incidental expenses will be reimbursed to participate in the interview process. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Legal disputes, if any, will be restricted within the jurisdiction of Mumbai only. Candidates are advised to visit the website of IIM Mumbai (www.iimmumbai.ac.in) regularly for any updates, amendments, and corrigendum, which will be placed only on the institute website.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 contractual vacancies, consisting of 1 post of Facility administrator and 2 posts of Centre Attendant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the posts?
faq.answer: Facility administrator requires Any Graduate or Diploma with 3 years of industry experience, while Centre Attendant requires a minimum of 10th Pass or Diploma with 5 years of work experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be not more than 40 years of age as of the closing date, 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Facility administrator carries a monthly remuneration of Rs 30,000 to Rs 40,000, while Centre Attendant carries Rs 25,000 to Rs 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application processing fee is Rs 590. Candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwD, and internal candidates are exempt from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting followed by an interview, which may be held in person or online.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job at IIM Mumbai?
faq.answer: No, the positions are purely contractual initially for one year, extendable with a maximum tenure of two years, with no claim for regularisation.

faq.question: Q9. Do candidates who previously applied for Centre Attendant need to apply again?
faq.answer: No, candidates who have already applied for the post of Centre Attendant need not apply again as their earlier applications will be considered.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates must bring all original certificates, degrees, and other documents pertaining to their educational qualification, professional qualification, work experience, age, etc., along with one set of photocopies.
